basic.name: Straight Bet
basic.description_template: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Aventurine's DEF to one designated enemy target.

skill.name: Cornerstone Deluxe
skill.description_template: Provides all allies with a "Fortified Wager" shield that can block DMG equal to {{shield_def}}% of Aventurine's DEF plus {{shield_flat}}, lasting for 3 turn(s). When "Fortified Wager" is gained repeatedly, the Shield effect can stack, up to 200% of the current Shield effect provided by the Skill.

ultimate.name: Roulette Shark
ultimate.description_template: Randomly gains 1 to 7 points of "Blind Bet". Then, inflicts Unnerved on one designated enemy target for 3 turn(s) and deals Imaginary DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Aventurine's DEF to that enemy. When an ally hits an Unnerved enemy target, the CRIT DMG dealt increases by {{crit_dmg_up}}%.

talent.name: Shot Loaded Right
talent.description_template: For any single ally with "Fortified Wager", their Effect RES increases by {{effect_res}}%. When they get attacked, Aventurine gains 1 point of "Blind Bet". When Aventurine has "Fortified Wager", he can resist Crowd Control debuffs once every 2 turn(s). Aventurine additionally gains 1 point of "Blind Bet" after getting attacked. Upon reaching 7 points of "Blind Bet", Aventurine consumes the 7 points to launch a 7-hit Follow-Up ATK, with each hit dealing Imaginary DMG equal to {{def_ratio}}% of Aventurine's DEF to one random enemy. "Blind Bet" is capped at 10 points.

technique.name: The Red or the Black
technique.description:
After using the Technique, 1 of the following effects will be granted:
There is a chance for DEF to increase by 24%.
There is a high chance for DEF to increase by 36%.
There is a small chance for DEF to increase by 60%.

When this Technique is used repeatedly, the acquired effect with the highest buff value is retained.
When the next battle starts, increases all allies' DEF by the corresponding value, lasting for 3 turn(s).

2.name: Leverage
2.description: For every 100 of Aventurine's DEF that exceeds 1600, increases his own CRIT Rate by 2%, up to a maximum increase of 48%.

4.name: Hot Hand
4.description: When battle starts, grants all allies a "Fortified Wager" shield, whose Shield effect is equal to 100% of the one provided by the Skill, lasting for 3 turn(s).

6.name: Bingo!
6.description: After an ally with "Fortified Wager" launches a Follow-Up ATK, Aventurine accumulates 1 "Blind Bet" point. This effect can trigger up to 3 time(s), and its trigger count resets at the start of Aventurine's turn. After Aventurine launches his Talent's Follow-Up ATK, provides all allies with a "Fortified Wager" that can block DMG equal to 7.2% of Aventurine's DEF plus 96, and additionally grants a "Fortified Wager" of the same value to the ally with the lowest Shield effect, lasting for 3 turns.

eidolons.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
eidolons.description: Increases CRIT DMG by 20% for allies with "Fortified Wager". After using the Ultimate, provides all allies with a "Fortified Wager" shield, whose Shield effect is equal to 100% of the one provided by the Skill, lasting for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Bounded Rationality
eidolons.description: When using Basic ATK, reduces the target's All-Type RES by 12% for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Droprate Maxing
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Unexpected Hanging Paradox
eidolons.description: When triggering his Talent's Follow-Up ATK, first increases Aventurine's DEF by 40% for 2 turn(s), and additionally increases the Hits Per Action for his Talent's Follow-Up ATK by 3.

eidolons.name: Ambiguity Aversion
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Stag Hunt Game
eidolons.description: For every ally that holds a Shield, the DMG dealt by Aventurine increases by 50%, up to a maximum increase of 150%.
